## Textbooks

### Core Texts (Available via Library)

Both core textbooks are available as e-books through the Goldsmiths Library:

- **Coolican, H. (2017). *Research methods and statistics in psychology* (6th Ed.). Hodder and Stoughton.**
  - [Access via VLeBooks](https://www.vlebooks.com/Product/Index/1994423?page=0&startBookmarkId=-1)
  - [Direct reader link](https://r3.vlebooks.com/Reader?ean=9780203769836)

- **Harris, P. (2008). *Designing and reporting experiments in psychology* (3rd Ed.). Open University Press.**
  - [Access via VLeBooks](https://www.vlebooks.com/Product/Index/155270?page=0&startBookmarkId=-1)
  - [Direct reader link](https://r4.vlebooks.com/Reader?ean=9780335235483)

::: {.callout-tip}
## Accessing E-Books
You'll need to log in with your Goldsmiths credentials. If you have trouble accessing, contact the library.
:::

## Software

### WebR (In-Browser)

All lab activities use **WebR**—R that runs directly in your browser. You don't need to install anything.

### R and RStudio (Optional)

If you want to install R on your own computer:

- [Download R](https://cran.r-project.org/)
- [Download RStudio](https://posit.co/download/rstudio-desktop/)

## Online Statistics Resources

### Visual & Interactive

- [Seeing Theory](https://seeing-theory.brown.edu/) — Beautiful visual introduction to probability and statistics
- [Statistics by Jim](https://statisticsbyjim.com/) — Clear explanations of statistical concepts
- [Stat Trek](https://stattrek.com/) — Statistics tutorials and calculators

### R Resources

- [R for Data Science](https://r4ds.had.co.nz/) — Free online textbook
- [RStudio Primers](https://posit.cloud/learn/primers) — Interactive tutorials
- [Quick-R](https://www.statmethods.net/) — R syntax reference

## Writing & APA Style

### APA Format

- [Purdue OWL APA Guide](https://owl.purdue.edu/owl/research_and_citation/apa_style/) — Comprehensive APA formatting guide
- [APA Style Website](https://apastyle.apa.org/) — Official APA resources

### Academic Writing

- [Goldsmiths Academic Skills](https://www.gold.ac.uk/students/skills/) — Writing support
- [Phrasebank](https://www.phrasebank.manchester.ac.uk/) — Academic phrases and structures

## Hypothesis Annotation

This module uses **Hypothes.is** for collaborative annotation. You can highlight and comment on course materials, and see comments from other students.

- [Hypothes.is website](https://hypothes.is/)
- Look for the Hypothes.is sidebar on course pages
